title: 'flowrpot' - Art & Production
description: 'flowrpot' is a Toronto-based hip-hop artist. I was responsible for designing the visual identity for his self-titled mixtape, including the cover art, promotional materials, and social media graphics. Additionally, I produced and engineered all 13 tracks on the mixtape, blending electronic beats with soulful melodies to create a unique sound that complements flowrpot's vocals.

title: Virality (Audio Tool Website)
description: 'Virality' is a web-based audio tool that allows users to create and share slowed + reverb, or nightcore sound clips. I designed and developed the entire user interface, including the interactive audio editor. The design is heavily inspired by the handheld PSP UI, with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Users can upload their own audio files, apply effects, and export their creations for free, directly from the website.
